Show a clickable ball on any screen, STT→LLM→TTS for voice chat anytime (needs floating window and mic permission). Master switch for voice.
When an AI text reply is received, automatically read it aloud with TTS.
Reading uses the model and provider selected on the "TTS" page; changeable in "Voice Service → TTS"; the voice ball chat and digital human use the same global setting.
Show a voice input button next to the input box; press and hold to speak, release to end, recognized text fills the input.
By default, write the chat into "the dialog currently being viewed"; after enabling, pin it to a specific session.
Auto-launch the resident voice ball after boot (with notification bar), no auto-listen; waits for tap to start.
When enabled, AI replies naturally weave in emotion / tone, making the voice warmer. Emotion source auto-follows the provider selected in "TTS".
Current voice source is local system TTS, which does not parse emotion tags; the AI conveys emotion via natural language (wording / interjections), with no extra emotional inflection in reading.

To change the emotion effect, go to "Voice Service → TTS" and switch to a cloud provider (e.g. Xiaomi MiMo for the best emotional synthesis). Auto-read and digital human use the same global setting, no separate config.
When enabled, the AI auto-assigns different voices to different paragraphs by content (e.g. narration / character voice), and can "synthesize while playing" seamlessly.
